source: https://www.evisa.gov.az/en/apply-step1, /en/countries, /en/conditions and /en/information, all read 2026-08-30. The first application screen and public conditions identify the choices and preparation items below. Later live-form HTML validation attributes, regexes, character limits and field error text were not publicly readable, so no pattern or length is claimed.

visa_free_status.label: Visa-free status
visa_free_status.help: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs maintains ordinary-passport visa-free arrangements, including time-limited schemes. Check the exact passport and travel date before opening a paid application.

errors.required: Check whether this passport needs a visa before paying

nationality.label: Nationality or citizenship
nationality.placeholder: As shown by the travel document
nationality.help: The first ASAN application screen asks for nationality or citizenship. Select the country tied to the travel document you will use.

travel_document_type.label: Travel document or passport type
travel_document_type.help: Choose the document type shown on the first application screen. Refugee-status holders are directed to an Azerbaijani diplomatic mission instead of this portal.

passport_validity.label: Travel document validity
passport_validity.help: The travel document must remain valid for at least 3 months after the e-Visa expires.

passport_scan.label: Travel document photo-page scan
passport_scan.help: ASAN makes the applicant responsible for a readable scan of the page containing the photo. An unreadable copy can lead to refusal.

travel_start.label: Planned arrival date
travel_start.placeholder: Allow 3 working days for standard service
travel_start.help: Standard applications must be made at least 3 working days before arrival. Urgent applications use a separate 3-hour service.

email.label: Email address
email.help: Application, payment and decision notices are sent to this address. ASAN tells applicants to enter it correctly and offers a status checker if mail does not arrive.

errors.required: An accessible email address is required

payment_card.label: Payment card
payment_card.help: The portal accepts Visa, Mastercard and UnionPay. The card does not have to be in the applicant's name. The USD 20 state fee and USD 5 service fee are non-refundable.
